tweet.text:
🚀Zhipu has introduced GLM-Legal, a legal AI model built on GLM-5.3-Flash.

It targets end-to-end legal workflows, not just one-off Q&A, covering tasks such as contract review, evidence analysis, and cross-border compliance planning.

On Harvey LAB, GLM-Legal achieved a 19.2% all-pass rate, up 12.5 percentage points over its base model.

Beta access is now open for applications.
